Laura — attaching our standard redaction_checklist.pdf and a short guidance doc for handling support logs with PHI. High level:
- Remove direct identifiers (names, emails, phone numbers).
- Mask timestamps only when they uniquely identify a customer incident (use rolling windows).
- Replace customer IDs with hashed tokens and keep a mapping offline if needed for reviewers.

I included a suggested metadata sheet layout (rows: filename, owner, sensitivity, redaction_needed, redactor). Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Attachment: redaction_checklist.pdf

Ben Rhodes
Senior HR Compliance Consultant
TalentOps
